description.p: Cosmic Scout is a profile-driven calculator for the cycles that shape a person's day, week and month — circadian, ultradian, seasonal and lunar — alongside a Cosmos wing of astrological and earth traditions. It grades everything it shows by whether a channel of influence can be named and traced, and it runs entirely offline except for one clearly opt-in feature and the Cosmos link checks you start yourself.
City lookup uses data derived from GeoNames (geonames.org), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

description.p: Cosmos Further Reading links on every tab, including Moon and Sky. Links are saved with each profile; add and delete freely. Check links tests each site on request and marks it confirmed, refused or unreachable.
Runtime update: PyQt6 on the KDE 6.11 runtime with Python 3.13. Runs natively on Wayland, with X11 as a fallback. No feature changes. Fixes a crash when opening an empty-state row on the Dashboard.

Initial release. Dashboard composite guidance engine, cycles pages, records with journal and pattern analysis, Cosmos wing (Moon and Sky, tropical, sidereal, BaZi, Shengxiao, earth traditions), and opt-in NOAA space weather.
